title: Shinglewake Shore
description: A scalloped sandy lake margin with contrasting wet cobbles, loose shingle and grass tufts. Water is on the negative Y side, at Z=0.

review.notes: Round 2. Fixed: the grass/sand edge is now a smooth natural transition; the water is rendered and the close-up shows the waterline; grass is in varied clumps. Not fixed: (1) there is no darker wet sand strip along the waterline (closeup.jpg) - sand is the same dry beige right up to the water; add a 0.5-1.5 m darker, slightly glossy wet band. (2) Rocks are low-poly faceted boxes with flat planes and all the same light grey; wet and dry stones look identical. Round and vary them, and make stones in/at the water darker and glossier. (3) The small pebbles are scattered evenly like confetti across the whole beach; cluster them along the waterline and drift lines. (4) The water is a saturated flat blue; shift towards the blue-green of water_opaque with a shallower, lighter band at the shore. (5) The embankment is still a smooth green ramp; add exposed roots/soil breaks and stones in the bank.
